reason: H0 exercises only one valid initialization call with sizeof dec and WUFFS_VERSION, ignores the newly returned wuffs_base__status, and immediately proceeds to normal decoding. It cannot exercise the changed initialization API's null receiver, incorrect sizeof_star_self, incompatible wuffs_version, repeated-call, nested-initializer failure, or post-failure/retry states. These paths now return errors directly instead of recording several failures in private_impl.status, making the call protocol and receiver state fuzz-worthy independently of GIF or zlib byte parsing.
evidence: gif_fuzzer.c calls wuffs_gif__decoder__check_wuffs_version(&dec, sizeof dec, WUFFS_VERSION) exactly once and does not capture its return value.
zlib_fuzzer.c calls wuffs_zlib__decoder__check_wuffs_version(&dec, sizeof dec, WUFFS_VERSION) exactly once and does not capture its return value.
S1 changes every listed check_wuffs_version function from void to wuffs_base__status WUFFS_BASE__WARN_UNUSED_RESULT.

The changed implementations expose WUFFS_BASE__ERROR_BAD_RECEIVER, WUFFS_BASE__ERROR_BAD_SIZEOF_RECEIVER, WUFFS_BASE__ERROR_BAD_WUFFS_VERSION, and WUFFS_BASE__ERROR_CHECK_WUFFS_VERSION_CALLED_TWICE as direct return values.
wuffs_gif__decoder__check_wuffs_version now propagates failure from wuffs_lzw__decoder__check_wuffs_version before setting private_impl.magic.
wuffs_zlib__decoder__check_wuffs_version and wuffs_gzip__decoder__check_wuffs_version now propagate failures from their nested decoder and checksum initializers before setting private_impl.magic.
H0 has no harness for wuffs_gzip__decoder__check_wuffs_version or direct initialization of the deflate, LZW, Adler-32, and CRC-32 objects.
recommended_action: Add an initialization-protocol fuzzer that derives receiver choice, sizeof_star_self, wuffs_version, call count, and subsequent operation sequence from fuzz input; assert returned statuses and safely exercise retry and post-failure calls for GIF, zlib, gzip, deflate, LZW, Adler-32, and CRC-32 objects. Update the existing GIF and zlib harnesses to capture and handle the check_wuffs_version return status.
